shortDescription: Manage DNS settings on a BIG-IP

options.name: cache
options.description: Specifies whether the system caches DNS lookups or performs the operation each time a lookup is needed. Note this applies only to Access Policy Manager (APM) features, such as ACLs, web application rewrites, and authentication.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: Specifies whether the DNS specifies IP addresses using IPv4 or IPv6.

options.name: name_servers
options.description: A list of name servers the system uses to validate DNS lookups

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: search
options.description: A list of domains the system searches for local domain lookups, to resolve local host names.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the variable on the system. When C(present), guarantees an existing variable is set to C(value).
